claims.statement: For every signed simple graph H (signs +/-1, n vertices, maximum degree Delta) and integer r > 4 Delta, the positive simple unweighted graph G(H,r) with 6nr vertices contains an embedded invariant torus F(T^n) carrying the signed dynamics exactly; F maps equilibrium germs onto equilibrium germs, identifies Lyapunov-stable sets, and the Jacobian spectrum at F(phi*) is that at phi* plus eigenvalues <= -(r/2 - 2 Delta).
claims.notNew: The invariance step is of a known coupled-cell type; novelty is claimed for the uniform normal bound and its quantitative consequences only, within a bounded search.

claims.statement: G_{6,9} (324 vertices, 3726 edges, 23-regular, connected) has an equilibrium theta* with equilibrium germ R x C(S^1 x S^1), all nearby equilibria Lyapunov stable; neither the equilibrium set nor the stable set is a countable union of closed embedded topological manifolds without boundary or of immersed compact manifolds without boundary.

On K_n the equilibrium set is a finite union of closed embedded smooth manifolds iff a countable union of closed embedded topological manifolds iff a countable union of immersed compact manifolds iff n is odd or n <= 4.
claims.notNew: Short corollary of classical polygon geometry and Burns et al. Theorem 16.1 plus the cover lemmas.

claims.statement: Sclosa's Conjecture 1.3 is false in its published (closed-manifold) wording, its countable version, its immersed-compact version and its relatively-closed version; it is true in its literal arXiv v1 wording (manifolds not necessarily closed) and for manifolds with boundary or corners.
For every m = 2k+4 >= 6 and r > 2(m-2), G_{m,r} has a stable equilibrium continuum with germ R x C(S^k x S^k), with no countable closed or immersed compact cover of the equilibrium set or stable set.
evidence: G_{8,13} cone point: no positive eigenvalue, nullity 7 (proof audit)

claims.statement: G_{4,5} (120 vertices, 13-regular) has an open and closed set of stable equilibria that is the image of three embedded 2-tori meeting cleanly along aligned circles; nullity 3 at aligned balanced points.
For odd m >= 3 and r > 2(m-2), F(B_m) is a compact smooth (m-2)-manifold of stable equilibria of G_{m,r}, a union of components, with nullity exactly m-2.
claims.notNew: Sclosa (2023) already has stable equilibrium manifolds of every dimension.

claims.statement: At the cone point of G_{6,r}: unstable for r <= 7 (eigenvalue 4 - r/2 > 0), degenerate and undetermined for r = 8, stable for r >= 9.
A 36-vertex weighted version (ring weight K = 9) has the same stable cone germ.

doNotRead: the literal arXiv v1 wording of Conjecture 1.3 as refuted (it is true)
any result as robust to generic perturbation of weights or frequencies
any statement about heterogeneous networks such as power grids
the local cone homeomorphism (Lemma 7) as a new result
internal AI-assisted review as peer review
